# Lockheed Martin to Acquire Ultra Maritime

BETHESDA, Md., July 15, 2026 -- Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE: LMT) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Ultra Maritime from Advent International for approximately $1.5 billion in cash. Ultra Maritime develops undersea sensing and sonobuoy systems and will be part of the Rotary and Mission Systems segment.

The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.

"Ultra Maritime expands our undersea warfare portfolio," said Jim Taiclet, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer. The acquisition is expected to be accretive to earnings in the first full year after closing.

About Lockheed Martin: Headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, Lockheed Martin is a global defense technology company.
